data: {"type":"agent_chunk","agent":"synthesizer","content":"## How CRISPR Gene Editing Works

CRISPR-Cas9 delivers the Cas9 nuclease and a synthetic guide RNA into a cell, and the complex cuts the genome at a chosen location [7]. The cell then repairs the break. Repair errors can switch off or break the gene, or researchers can supply a new DNA template to add a function [3].

The system comes from a bacterial antiviral defense that protects bacteria from viral invasion [1][7].

## Where It Is Used

Researchers commonly use CRISPR to knock out genes [2]. It can also replace a disease-causing mutation with a healthy sequence [2].

## Expanding Scope

CRISPR SWAPnDROP extends genome editing to large-scale DNA transfer between bacterial species [4]. In cell culture, CRISPR-Cas editing has eliminated HIV [6].

## Caveats

- The uses claim and the HIV claim each rest on a single source, so they need corroboration.
- The HIV result is from cell culture, not from patients.
- The sources do not cover recent clinical status, which a November 2026 review would need.
- Off-target cutting, delivery challenges, and immune responses are not addressed here, so the system's readiness for therapeutic use should not be overstated.

### Sources

1. [CRISPR as a strong gene editing tool](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5319660) - Web, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
2. [What is CRISPR? - Innovative Genomics Institute (IGI)](https://innovativegenomics.org/what-is-crispr) - Web, innovativegenomics.org
3. [What Is Gene Editing? How Does CRISPR Work?](https://www.americangene.com/blog/what-is-gene-editing-how-it-works-in-2-minutes) - Web, americangene.com
4. [CRISPR SWAPnDROP -- A multifunctional system for genome editing and large-scale interspecies gene transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.11880) - arXiv, preprint, Nov 2021
5. [CRISPR gene-editing breakthrough opens door to treating broad array of diseases](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=27643517) - Hacker News, 600 points, 234 comments, Jun 2021
6. [HIV in cell culture can be completely eliminated using CRISPR-Cas gene editing (pdf)](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39761283) - Hacker News, 324 points, 77 comments, Mar 2024
7. [CRISPR gene editing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CRISPR_gene_editing) - Wikipedia
"}
